name: tyrannosaurus
draw: Side view of a bipedal T. rex with a huge boxy head, open toothy jaw, tiny two-fingered arms and a thick tail held level.

name: triceratops
draw: Side view of a four-legged horned dinosaur with a wide bony neck frill, two long brow horns and a short nose horn.

name: stegosaurus
draw: Side view of a four-legged dinosaur with a small head, a double row of tall diamond plates along its arched back and tail spikes.

name: velociraptor
draw: Side view of a slim running raptor with a long stiff tail, feathered arms and one raised sickle claw on the foot.

name: ankylosaurus
draw: Side view of a low, wide armored dinosaur with a studded shell back, short legs and a round bony club at the tail tip.

name: parasaurolophus
draw: Side view of a duck-billed dinosaur with a long curved tube crest sweeping back from the top of its head.

name: corythosaurus
draw: Side view of a duck-billed dinosaur head and neck with a tall rounded half-disc crest like a helmet on top of the skull.

name: spinosaurus
draw: Side view of a long-snouted predator with a tall rounded sail rising along its back and a paddle-like tail.

name: baryonyx
draw: Side view of a crocodile-snouted predator without a sail, leaning forward with one oversized hooked thumb claw on each hand.

name: pachycephalosaurus
draw: Side view of a bipedal dinosaur with a thick domed skull ringed by small knobs, head lowered as if to butt.

name: pterodactyl
draw: Flying pterosaur seen from below with wide leathery wings, a long pointed beak and a backward pointing head crest.

name: quetzalcoatlus
draw: Giant pterosaur standing on all fours on the ground with folded wings, a very long neck and a huge spear-like beak.

name: rhamphorhynchus
draw: Flying pterosaur in side view with narrow wings, a toothy beak and a long thin tail ending in a small diamond vane.

name: plesiosaur
draw: Swimming marine reptile in side view with a very long thin neck, small head, broad body and four paddle flippers.

name: pliosaur
draw: Swimming marine reptile in side view with a short neck, huge long-jawed head full of teeth and four paddle flippers.

name: mosasaur
draw: Swimming giant sea lizard in side view with a long crocodile-like head, flippers and a shark-like downturned tail fin.

name: ichthyosaur
draw: Dolphin-shaped marine reptile in side view with a long thin toothy snout, a big round eye, dorsal fin and crescent tail.

name: dimetrodon
draw: Side view of a sprawling four-legged reptile with a tall fan-shaped sail of spines on its back and a big-toothed head.

name: iguanodon
draw: Side view of a large plant-eating dinosaur standing half upright, one hand raised to show its conical thumb spike.

name: carnotaurus
draw: Side view of a bipedal predator head and body with two short thick horns above the eyes and stubby tiny arms.

name: styracosaurus
draw: Side view of a horned dinosaur with one long nose horn and a frill edged with a crown of long backward spikes.

name: protoceratops
draw: Side view of a small stocky dinosaur with a parrot-like beak, a plain wide neck frill and no horns.

name: therizinosaurus
draw: Side view of a pot-bellied upright feathered dinosaur with a small head and three extremely long scythe claws on each hand.

name: dilophosaurus
draw: Side view of a slender bipedal predator head with two thin parallel half-moon crests running along the top of the skull.

name: oviraptor
draw: Feathered beaked dinosaur crouched on a ring-shaped nest of long eggs with its arms spread over them.

name: amargasaurus
draw: Side view of a smaller long-necked dinosaur with a double row of tall spines running up the back of its neck.

name: gallimimus
draw: Side view of an ostrich-like running dinosaur with a small beaked head, long neck, long legs and a straight tail.

name: microraptor
draw: Small gliding dinosaur seen from above with feathered wings on both arms and legs, four wings in total, and a fan tail.

name: kentrosaurus
draw: Side view of a four-legged dinosaur with short plates at the shoulders becoming long paired spikes down the back and tail.

name: tanystropheus
draw: Side view of a small lizard body with a ridiculously long stiff neck longer than its body and tail combined.

name: sabertooth-tiger
draw: Side view of a big muscular cat head and shoulders with an open jaw showing two very long downward saber canines.

name: aurochs
draw: Side view of a wild ox with a heavy shoulder hump and long thick horns curving forward and up.

name: terror-bird
draw: Side view of a tall flightless bird with tiny wings and an enormous deep hooked beak on a big head.

name: moa
draw: Side view of a very tall wingless bird with a long upright neck, small head and thick sturdy legs.

name: megalodon-jaw
draw: Front view of a giant open shark jaw, an arched oval ring lined with rows of triangular teeth.

name: megalodon-tooth
draw: Single large triangular fossil shark tooth with serrated edges and a darker root band across the base.

name: dunkleosteus
draw: Side view of an armored fish with a heavy plated head and sharp bony blade jaws instead of teeth, open wide.

name: stethacanthus
draw: Side view of an early shark with a flat brush-topped anvil-shaped fin sticking up from its back.

name: helicoprion
draw: Spiral whorl of triangular teeth coiled like a buzz saw blade, shown as a fossil in the lower jaw.

name: coelacanth
draw: Side view of a heavy lobe-finned fish with fleshy limb-like fins and a three-lobed tail with a small middle tuft.

name: tiktaalik
draw: Side view of a flat-headed fish crawling onto land, propped up on two stubby limb-like front fins.

name: ammonite
draw: Coiled spiral fossil shell with evenly spaced radial ribs, seen flat from the side.

name: belemnite
draw: Bullet-shaped pointed fossil guard with a short cone at the wide end, lying at an angle.

name: orthoceras
draw: Long straight cone-shaped fossil shell with evenly spaced chamber lines across it.

name: anomalocaris
draw: Top view of a flat swimming predator with side flaps along its body and two curled spiny grasping arms at the head.

name: opabinia
draw: Side view of a small segmented swimmer with five stalked eyes on its head and a long flexible clawed nozzle in front.

name: hallucigenia
draw: Side view of a tiny worm on paired thin legs with a row of long spikes pointing up from its back.

name: eurypterid
draw: Top view of a sea scorpion with a broad head, segmented tapering body, two paddle legs and a spiked tail.

name: arthropleura
draw: Top view of a giant flat millipede with many broad segmented body plates and legs along both sides.

name: crinoid-fossil
draw: Sea lily fossil with a long jointed stalk topped by a cup and feathery branching arms.

name: dinosaur-skeleton
draw: Side view of a mounted bipedal dinosaur skeleton with a skull, ribcage, bony legs and a tapering vertebra tail.

name: tyrannosaurus-skull
draw: Side view of a large predator skull with big openings, a deep jaw and a row of long pointed teeth.

name: triceratops-skull
draw: Three-quarter view of a horned skull with a broad frill, two long brow horns and a beak.

name: dinosaur-eggs-nest
draw: Three oval speckled eggs sitting together in a shallow bowl-shaped nest of earth.

name: dinosaur-hatchling
draw: Baby dinosaur head and neck poking out of a cracked egg with a jagged break line and shell pieces.

name: amber-fossil
draw: Rounded drop of amber with a small insect with wings trapped inside it.

name: fossil-shell
draw: Ribbed fan-shaped clam shell imprint set into a rough rounded rock.

name: dinosaur-tooth
draw: Single long curved serrated predator tooth, pointed at the tip and wider at the root.

name: dinosaur-claw
draw: Single large curved hooked claw with a bony base, like a raptor killing claw.

name: fossil-dig
draw: Dinosaur bone lying in layered ground below a small brush, the ground drawn as horizontal strata lines.

name: mammoth-tusk
draw: Single long ivory tusk curving in a wide arc, broad at the base and tapering to a point.

name: sabertooth-skull
draw: Side view of a cat skull with an open jaw and two very long downward saber canines.

name: flint-hand-axe
draw: Teardrop-shaped knapped stone hand axe with chipped facets across its face.

name: stone-age-club
draw: Wooden club with a rough stone head lashed to the top with crossed cord bindings.

name: stone-spear
draw: Long wooden spear shaft with a chipped stone point bound on with cord.

name: dolmen
draw: Prehistoric tomb of two upright standing stones supporting a wide flat capstone.

name: stone-circle
draw: Ring of standing stones in perspective with lintel stones across some pairs on top.

name: petroglyph
draw: Rounded boulder with a carved spiral and a small stick figure etched into its face.

name: griffin
draw: Side view of a creature with an eagle head, beak and wings on the front and a lion body and tufted tail behind.

name: pegasus
draw: Side view of a horse in mid gallop with large feathered wings raised from its shoulders.

name: centaur
draw: Side view of a figure with a human torso and arms on a horse body with four legs, holding a bow.

name: minotaur
draw: Front view of a bull head with long curved horns and a nose ring on a broad human chest and shoulders.

name: medusa
draw: Front view of a woman's face whose hair is a crown of writhing snakes with small heads.

name: cyclops
draw: Front view of a giant head with a single large eye in the middle of the forehead and a heavy brow.

name: cerberus
draw: Front view of a dog body with three dog heads side by side on separate necks, wearing a spiked collar.

name: chimera
draw: Side view of a lion with a goat head rising from its back and a snake head as its tail.

name: harpy
draw: Bird body with large wings and taloned feet topped by a woman's head with long hair.

name: satyr
draw: Figure with small curled horns, a pointed beard and goat legs with hooves, holding pan pipes.

name: sphinx
draw: Side view of a reclining lion body with a human head wearing a striped headdress.

name: hippocampus
draw: Side view of a sea horse creature with a horse head, front legs and mane joined to a curling fish tail.
